issueReference.title: Telescreen v1.1: features adopted from comparable sensitive-data monitoring systems (F1-F10)

reviewContext.userProblem: Telescreen v1 judges content only. DSPM, DLP and secret-scanner products judge risk as content x placement x exposure, confirm resolution by rescan, treat unscanned as unsafe, route to data owners and track exceptions with expiry. The owner asked to adopt F1-F10 as specified in design-v1-1-dspm-adoption.md while keeping every v1 data-handling guarantee.
requiredOutcomes: F1 exposure context on every resource scan and exposure-aware effective severity with the new critical level (base_severity kept).
F2 versioned placement policies with allow/violate, issue status allowed, re-evaluation by POLICY_REEVALUATE; a policy change never counts as remediation. F10 max_age_days as a policy condition.
F3 resolution reasons and verified resolution: pending_verification decided by verify_rescan; inconclusive rescans never resolve.
F4 per-job scan coverage and per-resource unscannable list; unscanned is never clean; non-quota 403 maps to FORBIDDEN/permission_denied while 404 stays ResourceGoneError.
F5 owner routing via keyed owner identities, owner_review human task kind, weekly digest and My tasks page; assignee=me fix.
F6 collector health (stale, watch_expiring, failing scans, unscannable_public) and police_silent alerts on existing list endpoints.
F7 linked occurrences by keyed fingerprint and fingerprint key versioning with version 1 as the identity key.
F8 ordinal risk score with configurable weights; sort and escalation (min_risk) by risk.
F9 exceptions with reason, approver (team lead or admin) and expiry; reopen on expiry; until_regressed.
Leak matrix extended to new tables, API responses, search documents, notifications, digests and logs with raw-sample, file-name and owner-email canaries.
mise run ci passes offline; src/web typecheck, vitest, build and the screenshot smoke (zero browser errors) pass; README, design docs and impl-plans index updated.
nonGoals: F11 ticket export, F13 custom classifiers, F16 evaluation harness (v1.2).
F12 automated remediation or any source write scope (owner decision: read-only).
F14 credential validity checks against providers (owner decision).
F15 reveal of raw values (owner decision: deep links to the source location only).
R1 semantic grouping or lineage; R2 endpoint or in-transit DLP.
Dependency changes (pyproject.toml, uv.lock, src/web/package.json, bun.lock) and edits to existing Alembic migrations.
constraints: AGENTS.md: English only, no emojis, python-coding-standards; plan files under 400 lines; Python files under 1000 lines (workflow/dsl/loader.py split by v11-p13).
Strict typing via tools/typelint.py, ruff ANN/PGH and ty; no weakening, no type-ignore or ty-ignore comments, no new per-file-ignores.

Raw detected values, file names, paths, titles and emails never persisted, logged, indexed, notified or returned; new records hold only enums, counts, timestamps, keyed HMAC references, ids, operator configuration and redacted text.
Provider principals are read only inside adapter coroutines; OwnerIdentity.value and PlacementRef.value are repr=False.
Default uv run pytest passes offline; integration tests marked and skipped without TELESCREEN_TEST_DATABASE_URL / TELESCREEN_TEST_MEILI_URL.
Police SDK never imports telescreen.*; contract minor version 1.1 adds optional closed resource_exposures; contract_version pattern unchanged.
New DTO fields, constructor parameters and router deps are appended with feature-off defaults so wiring.py keeps type-checking until v11-p19 binds them.
Database changes only via the new idempotent revision 0002_v1_1 (0001_initial builds from current metadata).

Conventions 7a: fixed findings only in addressedFeedback; verification lists only final passing commands; tolerated concurrent-sibling failures and mutation runs only in the Progress Log; offline-skipped integration tests and /tmp outputs are not risks.
A defect outside a plan's writePaths becomes a Reconciliation request in that plan's Progress Log, not an in-place fix.
designDecisionsAndRationale: R-1: version 1 stays the identity key for resource, grouping, placement and owner keys; only value fingerprints use the active key version, so key rotation never re-keys issues or counts as remediation.
R-2: issues.severity is the effective severity and base_severity is added, because filters, search, triggers and UI read severity.
R-3: PATCH can no longer set resolved or ignored; dedicated remediation, resolve and exception operations replace it; manual and auto stay readable legacy values.
R-4: placement stored as keyed references to immediate containers; repository selectors exact or owner/*; age falls back to first_seen.
R-5: exception approval through /api/exceptions by teams.lead_member_id or an admin, not a workflow human task.
R-6: public unscannable resources raise collector health unscannable_public instead of pseudo-issues.
R-7: health reported on existing collector and police list endpoints; no health_alerts table.
R-8: watch_expiring uses a 12-hour window; failure threshold defaults to 3.
R-9: secret_occurrences is a repository query over findings with a new index.
R-10: Police contract adds per-locator resource_exposures.
R-11: My tasks uses three list endpoints with the assignee=me fix.
R-12: rescanner reports inconclusive for incomplete content; detect maps it to error/scan_incomplete.

Wave DAG: vocabulary/ports, model/migration, contract and UI foundation first; routers (wave 3) separated from wiring (wave 4) because wiring.py builds every router; leak matrix and final gates last (wave 5).
intentionalTradeoffs: Concurrent full-suite gates in v11-p01, v11-p02, v11-p15, v11-p16 and v11-p19 tolerate failures only in named sibling-owned paths, proven by a deselect rerun, an exclude rerun or a grep; those runs are Progress Log evidence, not manifest verification entries. v11-p21 runs the final gates with no tolerances.

v11-p10 edits exactly one v1 assertion in tests/collectors/google/test_sweep.py (line 188, FETCH_FAILED -> FORBIDDEN for the non-quota 403 file), enforced by a git diff --stat check in the plan; 404 -> REMOVED assertions unchanged.
tests/issues/test_issues_api.py is written sequentially by v11-p05 (wave 2) and v11-p17 (wave 3, dependsOn v11-p05).
The screenshot smoke is a hard gate only in v11-p21; v11-p16 may record issues-route failures caused by the concurrent v11-p15 as informational.
supportedEdgeCases: Only TELESCREEN_FINGERPRINT_KEY set: fingerprints, resource keys and key id byte-identical to v1.
Both FINGERPRINT_KEY and FINGERPRINT_KEYS set, missing version 1, or unconfigured active version: ConfigError with a static message.
v1-migrated database gains v1.1 tables and columns idempotently; fresh databases already have them from 0001.
Police 1.0 envelopes still validate; 1.1 envelopes with resource_exposures validate in both Bureau and SDK.
Rescan with incomplete content is inconclusive and never resolves; resource gone (404) records resource_deleted.
Policy allow then violate: violate wins; policy change moves open -> allowed without counting as remediation.
Exception expiry reopens the issue; until_regressed exceptions end on regression.
Token without a member passing assignee=me gets no unfiltered list.
outOfScopeEdgeCases: Live PostgreSQL/Meilisearch behavior beyond marked integration tests skipped offline.
Real external services (Slack, Google, GitHub, SMTP, LLM providers) and real docker compose up.
PolicyReevaluateHandler explicit rejection of requested exceptions with decided_by=system (low residual; approving such a request returns 409).
Glob forms other than owner/*, folder ancestry and path selectors in placement policies.
